'''Falsta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] when he tried to take Han Solo in.<ref name="Scoundrels" />

Falsta was short and scrawny and wore a leather jacket typically over a flame-bird shirt. He carried a heavily modified Clone Wars-era [[DT-57 "Annihilator" blaster/Legends|DT-57 blaster]] which he claimed was once owned by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. No one appeared to believe this claim.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
